findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice mcqs for Chapter 4 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 105 questions numbered 1-105; by section: 4.1 22, 4.2 12, 4.3 9, 4.4 4, 4.5 6, 4.6 17, 4.7 18, 4.8 10, 4.9 7. Keys: {'a': 26, 'b': 27, 'c': 26, 'd': 26}.

Covers sections 4.1-4.9 in order (mole, molar mass, Avogadro's number, molar volume, density of gases, molar concentration, stoichiometric relationships, limiting and excess reactants, yields, medicine). Numericals use values changed from the book's examples, molar masses are given in each question, and every value was recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. No question relies on a printed misprint (18.3 mol, 273.16 K, 0.02 mol Fe2O3, 1.81 g NH3 and 17.0 for N2, 163.93 for acetic anhydride, NaHCO3(g), the unbalanced NaNO3 equation).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
